name: Misono Karin
source:
Misono Karin is a model office lady. At work, she's the ever-reliable, hypercompetent boss. At home, well... Let's just say she's happily living a well-rounded life.

Looks like her unbelievably cute subordinate has today once again made a mess of things. She'll have to steel her heart and give her a stern talking-to!

[i]"W-what happens at home stays at home! We're keeping work and life seperate, got it?"[/i]

[Translated from [url=https://x.com/natukon_circle/status/2096218993854189793/photo/1]the author's Twitter.[/url]]
